_: The questions put to counsel, condensed for the screen. Each `needle` must appear in `doc` (whitespace-normalised), so a question cannot be reworded on screen without the source instruction saying it too. Gate 15 has no questionnaire yet; its four points are from open-work #15.

questions.label: Lawful basis and necessity
questions.text: We propose legitimate interest, Article 6(1)(f). Does it hold for records of unknown natural-person status? Answer separately for the raw XML, the tables and the flag files.

questions.label: A counts-only measurement
questions.text: May we run counts-only queries over what we already hold, to see how the indicator is spread by organisation role and country? No field value in any output. On what conditions, and until when?

questions.label: Retention
questions.text: What retention period, review trigger and deletion criteria apply to today's holdings, including derived copies and backups? The September 2027 review date is not permission.

questions.label: Article 14
questions.text: What information duty arises from indirect collection, on what timing, and does an exception apply? If Article 14(5)(b) is relied on, which safeguards?

questions.label: DPIA
questions.text: Is a data protection impact assessment required under Article 35? None is claimed completed.

questions.label: Security and access
questions.text: Local disk, gitignored, no third-party sync. That is policy, not an audited control. What is required?

questions.label: Rights and incidents
questions.text: How does a data-subject request reach the archive, the tables, the flags and the backups? How does an immutable raw archive yield to a valid erasure request?

questions.label: The baseline question
questions.text: May a flag point at a notice when the natural-person status of the organisations in it is unknown? Our default without an answer: no.

questions.label: A buyer, by definition
questions.text: We propose that set cannot include a natural person. Please scope three exceptions: utilities, subsidised contracts, voluntary notices.
questions.needle: ### B2. Corroborating a buyer from the legal definition, not from the data

questions.label: The supplier side
questions.text: Sole traders win public contracts, so no definition helps here. We propose holding suppliers until register cross-referencing exists. Is there anything short of that you would accept?

questions.label: Linking or naming?
questions.text: A flag carries a bid count, a market baseline and a URL to the notice on TED. That notice names the buyer. Is linking different from naming, under GDPR and Swedish förtal?
questions.needle: ### B4. Does linking differ from naming?

questions.label: Small cells
questions.text: Aggregates by country and CPV division can identify a notice by elimination when a cell is small. Our floor of 50 is statistical. Is an identifiability floor needed, and how large?

questions.label: Conflicting indicators
questions.text: Two contradictory natural-person indicators on one organisation. We propose treating it as a natural person. Is erring toward suppression the right resolution?

questions.label: Holding, pending a rule
questions.text: Is holding these values in the raw archive and the normalised tables acceptable while a rule is pending, and for how long?
questions.needle: **A1.** Is the current holding of these values

questions.label: Values already held
questions.text: Delete, rebuild under the chosen rule, or something else? How does the immutable raw archive yield to a valid obligation to remove?

questions.label: A counts-only scan
questions.text: May we scan for telephone-shaped strings to size the problem? Output: counts by column, nothing else.

questions.label: Articles 14 and 35
questions.text: Do the Article 14 and Article 35 duties change because these values are incidental, typed by the publisher outside any contact field?

questions.label: Which option
questions.text: Which of options 1 to 4 is adequate? Is a combination better, for example 4 for the descriptions and 1 for the rest?

questions.label: Is a pattern enough
questions.text: If a pattern rule is chosen: is an email-shaped pattern enough, or is a rule that misses phone numbers and names inadequate on its face?

questions.label: Linkability
questions.text: Does dropping a column change the source-linkability analysis? The notice stays public either way.

questions.label: Law or preference
questions.text: Is suppressing a value a public authority published on a public register a matter of law, or of our preference? Our rule says the law decides. We are asking for the law.
questions.needle: **B4.** Is suppressing a value that a public authority

questions.label: Any analysis at all
questions.text: Is any analysis of the beneficial-ownership subtree available, or is the answer simply no?
questions.needle: Whether any analysis of this subtree is available at all

questions.label: A relation, no names
questions.text: Is a stored yes-or-no, 'these two suppliers declare an owner in common' with nobody named, legally different from storing the owner?
questions.needle: whether a relation intended not to identify an individual

questions.label: Publication
questions.text: May any of it be published?
questions.needle: Whether any of it may be *published*

questions.label: Nationality
questions.text: Does nationality raise additional risks in context?
questions.needle: Whether `efac:Nationality` raises additional risks in context
